location_description:
Lincoln is a city in Placer County, California, United States, part of the Sacramento metropolitan area. Located in an area of rapid suburban development, it grew 282.1 percent between 2000 and 2010, making it the fastest-growing city over 10,000 people in the U.S. Its 2019 population was estimated to be 48,275.Lincoln is part of the Sacramento-Roseville Metropolitan Statistical Area.


== History ==
The original townsite was surveyed and laid out in 1859 by Theodore Judah along the proposed line of the California Central Railroad.
